question: President of India Draupadi Murmu received the first copy of which of the following books on the occasion of the Foundation Day celebrations of the National Commission for Women in New Delhi on 31 January 2023?
solution:
​The correct answer is __**Sashakt Nari Sashakt Bharat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **President of India Draupadi Murmu **receives the first copy of the book **"Shashakt Nari Sashakt Bharat"** on the occasion of the Foundation Day celebrations of the National Commission for Women in New Delhi on 31 January 2023.
 
• This book is a collection of 31 years of work of the National Commission for Women.
 
• It describes the various works done by the Commission, the efforts made to protect the rights of women and the measures taken to improve the status of women.
 
• The book has been edited by **Rekha Sharma, Chairperson of the National Commission for Women.**
 
• It also includes articles by former chairpersons and members of the Commission as well as other dignitaries.
 
• The purpose of publishing the book is to raise awareness about the status of women and their rights. It also reflects the work of the Commission and its efforts to protect the rights of women.
